snippet.title: [RF Online Next] Meet the Biosuit : Technician
snippet.description:
Introducing the Technician!

Specializing in combat support and healing allies, the Technician is a versatile and dependable ally in battle. It can simultaneously deploy support skills utilizing drones and towers along with long-range attacks, making it an essential asset in party battles.

Carry out diverse tactical operations with drones and towers, heal allies, and disrupt enemies—experience the Technician biosuit's combat capabilities today!
